about_ai_note: Developed with the support of AI coding assistants (Claude by Anthropic). Idea, architecture & design: yakuda.
about_text: Remap controller buttons for OpenVR and OpenXR games on Linux — with obah and xrBinder. The Controls tab from Yakuda Connect as a standalone app.
bd_chord_hint: All inputs together trigger the action.
bd_chord_no_more: There is no further button left that isn't already in this chord.
bd_deadzone_none: No binding in "Use as joystick" or "Use as trackpad" mode on this input — the deadzone only applies to those modes.
bd_deadzone_runtime_note: Note: the deadzone is saved as "deadzone_pct" in the OpenVR binding. xrizer doesn't evaluate this value yet. For xrizer games, switch on xrBinder instead and start the game — it then shows up as "· OpenXR" with a working deadzone.
bd_empty: Nothing is bound to this input in this action set yet. Add a binding on the left.
bd_footer_hint: Apply changes the layout in the view; save it there with "Save".
bd_param_tooltip: Text is stored as text. Prefix with "json:" to store JSON, e.g. json:0.5 or json:true
controls_busy_text: Another installation is already running. Please wait until it's done, then switch this on again.
controls_failed_text:
{name} could not be installed. The error message is shown in the terminal window; for Cargo also in ~/.config/openxr-vr-control/tools/cargo/<name>/install.log.

The switch has been turned off again.
controls_install_text:
{name} is not installed yet. How would you like to install it?

The installation runs in a terminal — you'll see every step and any errors there.
controls_method_appimage: ready-made file from GitHub, no sudo
controls_method_cargo: builds from source, works on any distro (Rust is installed if needed, takes a few minutes)
controls_method_flatpak: via Flathub, runs in a sandbox
controls_method_rpm: package from the GitHub release, installed with dnf
controls_obah_desc: Edit OpenVR bindings for xrizer, VapoR and OpenComposite in the terminal instead of writing the JSON files by hand.
controls_subtitle: Remap controller buttons for OpenVR and OpenXR games on Linux — with obah and xrBinder. If a tool is missing, the app asks how you want to install it.
lib_add_local_tip: Add a game without Steam (itch.io, GOG, your own build …). The action file is searched in the executable's folder.
lib_add_steam_tip: Add a Steam game (or a non-Steam game in Steam) that wasn't detected as a VR game.
lib_err_save_failed: The game could not be saved (see log).
lib_local_text: Add a game without Steam. The OpenVR action file is searched in the executable's folder — if none is found, you can pick it yourself afterwards with "📂 Action file …".
lib_remove_confirm:
Remove "{name}" from the list?

Saved bindings are kept.
lib_remove_tip: Removes a game you added yourself from the list. Nothing changes on the game itself.
lib_steam_text: All installed Steam games and non-Steam games in Steam that aren't in the list yet:
notice_obah_missing: obah is not installed — please install it for OpenVR games.
notice_xrb_missing: xrBinder is not installed — without it OpenXR games cannot be remapped. Please install it.
notice_xrb_off: xrBinder is off — remappings for OpenXR games only apply once it is switched on.
notice_xrb_rebuild: xrBinder needs a rebuild so remappings reach the game.
obah_aux_none: This action set has no matching actions.
obah_card_hint: Click to edit · drag to move
obah_chords_none: No chords. A chord fires an action when several buttons are pressed together.
obah_clear_manifest_tip: Forget the picked action file and search automatically again
obah_close_text: The bindings were changed but not saved yet. Save before closing?
obah_editor_count: {bound} of {total} inputs bound (in this action set)
obah_hint_missing: ⚠ File missing: {path} — obah would start empty here.
obah_no_games_hint: Lists Steam games that Steam marks as VR, installed Steam games with an OpenVR action file (actions.json or similar), and everything you add yourself via "+ Steam game" / "+ Local game".
obah_no_manifest_hint: ⚠ No OpenVR action file found (searched: {folder} and the Proton prefix). If it lives elsewhere, pick it with "📂 Action file …". Games using OpenXR directly have none — their controls come from the game itself.
obah_pick_manifest_invalid:
This is not an OpenVR action file (the "actions" list is missing):
{path}
obah_pick_manifest_tip: Pick this game's OpenVR action file (actions.json, steamvr_manifest.json or similar) yourself. It is remembered.
obah_profile_failed_text: The profile could not be written. See the log for details.
obah_profile_layout_only: Layout only — the bindings belong to a different controller.
obah_profile_other_text:
This profile was saved for {profile}, but {current} is selected.

Bindings don't carry over to a different controller and are skipped. Apply the layout only?
obah_profile_overwrite_text: A profile "{name}" already exists. Overwrite it?
obah_save_failed_text:
The file could not be written:

{error}
obah_tidy_tip: Shows only the input names. Right-click a card to show or hide it individually.
obah_unsaved_text: The bindings were changed but not saved yet. What should happen to them?
promo_dcb: VRChat chatbox with music, hardware info & plugins
promo_yc: WiVRn dashboard for Pico & Quest on Linux
tools_cargo_no_terminal: Error: No supported terminal found (konsole, kitty, foot, alacritty ...)!
tools_cargo_running: 🦀 Running in the terminal — progress and errors are shown there
xrb_bindings_guessed: assuming xrizer's default layout (the runtime reports no buttons)
xrb_build_failed:
xrBinder could not be built.

Log: {log}
xrb_card_desc: Remap buttons for OpenXR games without SteamVR bindings (e.g. Unreal games under Proton). The games appear in the game list below with “· OpenXR”.
xrb_card_hint: Click a button: assign or disable functions
xrb_cleanup_done:
The hand-copied xrBinder files are now here:
{path}
xrb_cleanup_system: This file is outside your home folder and is left alone. Please remove it manually.
xrb_debug_log_missing:
No log yet. It is created on the next game start (after “Rebuild”):
{path}
xrb_debug_log_tip: Open the xrBinder layer log from the last game start (for bug reports).
xrb_editor_status: OpenXR · xrBinder  ·  {bound} of {total} buttons bound  ·  {changed} changed
xrb_foreign:
A second xrBinder installation was found (copied by hand?). The layer would be loaded twice:
{paths}
xrb_from_yc_tip: Uses the xrBinder installation from Yakuda Connect ({path}) — no second build needed. Per-game settings are shared by both apps.
xrb_game_tip: OpenXR game — buttons are remapped in the background by xrBinder
xrb_hint_disabled_card: xrBinder is off — switch on the “xrBinder” card above, then start the game.
xrb_hint_no_actions: No actions known for this game yet. Start it once while OpenXR/VR-Controls is open.
xrb_hint_offline: The game is not running: changes apply on its next start.
xrb_hint_running: The game is running: after “Save” a new mapping applies immediately.
xrb_hint_template: The game reports no buttons (e.g. VRChat via xrizer). “🧩 Use OpenXR template” creates a default layout.
xrb_install_text:
xrBinder is built from source (git, cmake, C++ compiler). Missing tools are installed in the terminal, which may ask for your sudo password. Takes about a minute.

Install now?
xrb_obah_hint_running: ▶ Running as OpenXR right now: {games} — it's a separate entry with “· OpenXR” in the game list above. Remap it there.
xrb_obah_hint_xr: Does the game use OpenXR (e.g. Unreal)? Switch on xrBinder above and start it — it then appears here with “· OpenXR”.
xrb_reset_all_text: Undo all remappings for {game}? Nothing is written until you click “Save”.
xrb_reset_all_tip: Undo all remappings for this game
xrb_result_live: ✓ Saved and applied to the running game.
xrb_result_next_start: Saved. Applies on the next start of {game}.
xrb_result_restart: Saved. Removed mappings apply after restarting {game} (xrBinder cannot remove them live without crashing the game).
xrb_result_restart_axis: Saved. Deadzone/tilt take effect after restarting {game} (changing them live makes xrBinder crash the game).
xrb_service_failed: The xrBinder service (ipc_server) could not be started. Remapping still works, but running games will not show up here.
xrb_template_applied: Template: {matched} of {total} functions assigned – check and save
xrb_template_none: None of the game's functions match the template. Bind buttons by clicking a card.
xrb_template_tip: The game reports no buttons. Creates a common default layout (trigger, grip, sticks, buttons) – active only after “Save”, “Discard” undoes it.
xrd_deadzone_differs: Left and right are set differently – moving this slider sets both the same.
xrd_deadzone_hint: The deadzone applies to all of the game's stick directions on this stick (e.g. move, turn). Takes effect after “Apply” and “Save” – if the game is running, after a restart.
xrd_deadzone_none: No stick direction of the game on this stick.
xrd_deadzone_tip: Small movements around the center count as “stick at rest” – against stick drift (character walks or turns on its own).
xrd_deadzone_value_tip: How far the stick must move before the game sees it. Raise it if the stick still drifts.
xrd_hint: ✕ takes a function off the button: if it was moved here, it goes back; otherwise it is disabled. ↪ = moved to this button. ⇄ Tilt (stick press only) = also triggers when the stick is just tilted.
xrd_not_available: The game's controller profile does not provide this button right now
xrd_other_tip: Has no button on the detected controller — usually meant for another controller
xrd_tilt_threshold_tip: How far the stick must be tilted to count. Raise it if the stick drifts (triggers on its own).
xrd_tilt_tip: Also triggers when the stick is only tilted — no need to click it (e.g. for selecting and snap turn in older games).
